text: The Regional Infrastructure Fund (RIF) – Flood Resilience Co‑Funding is a New Zealand government initiative launched in July 2024 as part of Budget 2024. It aims to enhance regional flood resilience through a dedicated $200 million fund within the broader $1.2 billion RIF. The fund supports regional economic growth and infrastructure improvement by providing capital and operational expenditure for flood resilience projects. The initiative involves co-funding from regional and unitary councils, with a focus on mitigating flood risks exacerbated by climate change.
